storage: Keep sprigs dry in a box lined with paper towel in the fridge for about a week; leaves can be frozen on the stalk for a few months.
looksLike: Small, glossy, dark green leaflets on a thin stalk; crushed, they smell strongly of citrus and spice.
howToPick: Deep green, fragrant, glossy leaves still on the stalk. Avoid yellowing, blackened or limp leaves and a weak smell.
shelfLife: About a week in the fridge (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Bay leaf plus a little lime zest

usedIn.raw: 5 leaves per serving (weight not stated; about 0.8 g at the Kothu Parotta rate of 0.5 g per leaf)
